attr.title: Sternenfuchs
attr.desc: ARM64/PortMaster packaging of the open-source Star Fox Enhanced runtime, a fan-made SNES Star Fox/Starwing enhancement. No Nintendo ROM or ROM-derived data is included.
attr.inst:
This package does not include any Nintendo ROM data. Copy your own legally obtained Star Fox/Starwing `.sfc` or `.smc` ROM into `sternenfuchs/` before launching. The runtime validates it and builds a local `Starfox-Assets.BIN` on first run; it is never distributed with this port and never leaves the device.

Currently aarch64 (H700/Cortex-A53 class) only, tested on an Anbernic RG40XX H running KNULLI at 640x480. Renders through the device's OpenGL ES (the software/CPU renderer path is not usable through the bundled SDL3-to-SDL2 shim). Performance is CPU-bound single-core SNES CPU+PPU emulation; expect roughly 30-45 FPS in flight on this reference hardware rather than a locked 60.
